title: Nanjundi Kalyana
desc: To resolve familial conflict, a young man assumes a false identity to marry his cousin, orchestrated by his aunt in a complex scheme of reconciliation.

title: Taxiwala
desc: Shiva buys a car and becomes a taxi driver to earn a living, he soon realises that his car is possessed. Can he unearth the mystery behind the car?

title: Namma Basava
desc: Basava, a benevolent neighbor, courts Gowri, a talented musician. Unbeknownst to him, Pampathy, a wealthy and entitled individual, also vies for her affections.

title: Por Thozhil
desc: A rookie cop joins forces with a veteran officer to investigate a series of murders, leading them to a brutal serial killer determined to continue taking lives.

title: Neenena Avanu
desc: A young man's lover is murdered and he is left to be burnt alive by the killer. But he survives and receives a face transplant and sets out to avenge his lover's death.

title: Atte Maneya Daari
desc: The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.

title: Aacharya
desc: Acharya falls in love with Nisha and proposes to her, but she rejects him because his father's abuse of power caused suffering to her family.

title: Rustum
desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia

title: Anuraaga Aralithu
desc: Shankar, a humble factory worker, is compelled to marry his employer's arrogant daughter. Determined to change her ways, he sets out to teach her a lesson and curb her pride.

title: Superior
desc: Devarajan, a former criminal now working as a crane operator, struggles through hardships as he attempts to reunite with his estranged wife and son.

title: Jaguar
desc: Medical student Krishna hides a secret life as Jaguar, a deadly vigilante targeting a powerful group. His double life leads to thrilling chases and moral dilemmas.

title: Maanaadu
desc: On the day of a major conference, a bodyguard and a police officer find themselves hilariously stuck in a time loop, reliving the same chaotic moments over and over.

title: Gurudev Hoysala
desc: Gurudev Hoysala, an ethically sound police inspector, is relocated to Athani to probe a fellow officer's disappearance. However, the involvement of a dubious young couple complicates the case.

title: Obbanti Veera
desc: A sportsman travelling to a village for a match rescues a woman from a brutal faction leader and refuses to back down from danger.

title: Julayi
desc: Ravi happens to cross paths with Bittu, a gangster, and helps the police foil his plan to rob a bank. Eventually, Bittu resolves to destroy Ravi.

title: Chalaki
desc: Amid student demands, a male student enrolls in an all-girls college. Disinterested in studies, newcomer Aditya anticipates suspension, echoing past misadventures.

title: Madhagaja
desc: Undercover cop Gana risks it all in the crime-infested Ronapura, hunting down don Bhairathi Ranagallu, who's surprisingly driven by a quest for justice.
